skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 300% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Force Field] on all enemies for 1 turn. Before an affected enemy takes action, [Force Field] deals 400% ATK as DoT DMG and has an 80% chance to bypass immunity. Removes [Adhesion] and [Disable] from self.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 450% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Force Field] on all enemies for 1 turn. Before an affected enemy takes action, [Force Field] deals 600% ATK as DoT DMG and has an 80% chance to bypass immunity. Removes [Adhesion] and [Disable] from self.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: After an ally takes action, performs an [Ultimate Follow-Up] with 80% of the Ultimate’s DMG and its effects, up to 2 times per round. Absorbs 50% of [Detonation DMG] and converts it into [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: After an ally takes action, performs an [Ultimate Follow-Up] with 100% of the Ultimate’s DMG and its effects, up to 2 times per round. Absorbs 65% of [Detonation DMG] and converts it into [Specialized HP].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: After an ally takes action, performs an [Ultimate Follow-Up] with 120% of the Ultimate’s DMG and its effects, up to 2 times per round. Absorbs 80% of [Detonation DMG] and converts it into [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, summons Fubuki to assist in battle. Fubuki inherits 100% of Tatsumaki’s base ATK. When Tatsumaki uses a Basic Attack, Fubuki also performs a Basic Attack against 1 random enemy. When Tatsumaki uses her Ultimate, Fubuki also uses her Ultimate against all enemies, dealing DMG equal to 100% of her inherited ATK and triggering [Detonation] on enemies affected by [Force Field].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, summons Fubuki to assist in battle. Fubuki inherits 120% of Tatsumaki’s base ATK. When Tatsumaki uses a Basic Attack, Fubuki also performs a Basic Attack against 1 random enemy. When Tatsumaki uses her Ultimate, Fubuki also uses her Ultimate against all enemies, dealing DMG equal to 120% of her inherited ATK and triggering [Detonation] on enemies affected by [Force Field] with 160% effect. After any character takes action, Tatsumaki removes [Stun] and [Specialized Stun] from herself.

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
When an enemy carrying [Energy Suppression] damages the carrier, the damage is reduced by 20% and the reduction is converted into energy.
The shield absorbs damage up to a portion of the subject's Health; Charge DMG ignores it.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
While attacking, ignore the enemy's 30% Damage Immunity and Unique Defense to allow the attack to penetrate their shield.
Attack buff increases unit damage, often accompanied by [Shield Break].
The battlefield effect deals damage over time (100%) and can be detonated for a burst of damage, and helps the character recover from Stun after an action.
When dealing damage to health, forces the target to activate Energy Conversion, reducing the damage they deal and choking their mana source.
